newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 9.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Finance Minister S.A.M.S. Kibria said trading on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) was stopped on Sunday in a "planned Way." He asked the Investment Corporation of Bangladesh (ICB) to operate vigorously in the stock market.

BNP vice-chairman and deputy opposition leader in parliament, A.Q.M. Badruddoza Chowdhury, said Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, father of prime minister Sheikh Hasina, had rehabilitated the Razakars (those who opposed independence and helped the Pakistani occupation army).
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has sought Chinese investment, particularly in development of agriculture and agro-based enterprises in which China has attained tremendous success.

Production in the Chittagong Urea Fertilizer Limited (CUFL) may be disrupted from tomorrow as the Bakhrabad Gas System Ltd gave a notice saying gas supply will be reduced by 10 million cubic feet due to acute shortage.
The government has invited more than 60 eminent personalities from abroad to join the Silver Jubilee celebration of independence from december 13 to 17.
BNP leader Salahuddin Quader Chowdhury said they would be forced to build up street agitation if they are now allowed to speak in parliament.

Bangladesh Bank has decided to come forward in aid of the country's malfunctioning capital market. The bak's Governor Lutfur Rahman Sarker said the central bank would provide a fund amounting up to taka two billion at the disposal of the Investment Corporation of Bangladesh (ICB) for aggressive market operation.
Multi-dimensional complexity has developed in awarding contract under the Greater Dhaka Telecom Network Improvement Project.
